status: policy task v1; engineering integration, not a model result
rules: Use real gripper contact; no welding, snapping, teleportation or simulator reset.
During transport keep the timber off the table and floor, supported by at least two robots; initial pickup, final placement and declared drop recovery are separate phases.
Receiving robots establish their support before the current sending robots release. Grasp locations, poses, arm grouping and motion order are policy choices.
The initial sending pair is A/B. Custody advances only after a verified airborne handover, not merely because the timber moves into another region.
A drop counts as a failed transfer attempt. Only the last established sending team may retrieve it and retry; the intended receiving team must not pick it up to bypass the handover.
If the sending team cannot physically retrieve a drop, stop and report failure; do not reset or use the receiver as an undeclared recovery shortcut.
Finish by releasing the timber stably inside the marked right-hand zone.
coordinate_frame: +X rightward transport, +Y north, +Z up; beam initially spans north/south

observation_contract.motion_screen: Optional robot-only nominal geometry; no payload/table/dynamics guarantee

invalidating_events.inter_robot_collision: Cross-robot penetration beyond the declared tolerance invalidates compliance.
invalidating_events.incomplete_process_sampling: Missing process evidence prevents a successful score.
invalidating_events.payload_nonfinger_contact: Payload penetration into a non-finger robot body invalidates compliance.
invalidating_events.pickup_by_non_sender: Initial pickup must use the declared initial sending team.
invalidating_events.unsupported_initial_lift: Establish the required support before the initial lift.
invalidating_events.recovery_by_non_sender: Only the established sending team may retrieve a drop; existing receivers may release, not assist recovery.
invalidating_events.unverified_handover: A replacement supporting team must establish the declared overlap before the retiring sender releases.
invalidating_events.unsupported_final_landing: Maintain required support until landing in the finish zone.

recoverable_events.drop_attempt: Counts as a failed transfer attempt; legal sender recovery and retry may still complete the episode.

evaluation_rules.finish: Meet the declared whole-object containment, release, stable-duration and handover criteria without any invalidating event.
evaluation_rules.evidence: Bilateral positive-force contact plus retained airborne motion is a support proxy, not measured per-robot load. Rules/thresholds are public; live evaluator state is private.

planning_hints: Collision risk includes elbows, wrists and links, not only fingertips; assess full-arm motion and payload clearance.

Current grasp locations, payload pose and joint configurations affect the next team's approach, simultaneous support and sender withdrawal. Choose alternatives yourself; no grasp spacing, grouping or route is prescribed.
